prompt: A 3x2 GRID of SIX separate circular achievement medallions for a pirate fishing game, evenly spaced, each medallion its own self-contained round emblem, all six drawn in one consistent style. Soft painterly watercolour storybook illustration, warm hand-painted gouache feel, gentle soft-edged brushwork, subtle paper grain, no harsh outlines, no cel shading. Each medallion is a filled circular disc with a raised decorative rim and a single clearly readable subject centred inside it, painted as a small scene on the disc face. The set theme is THE SUNKEN HAND, the drowned finale of the campaign and the wreck left behind. Palette shifts colder than the rest of the collection: tarnished silver and dark bronze rims, bone white, deep indigo and abyssal black, with one restrained crimson accent. Do NOT depict any face or figure: the thing that was fought is shown only through what it left. IMPORTANT: the background BEHIND and BETWEEN all six medallions is a completely FLAT PURE MAGENTA field, RGB 255,0,255, absolutely uniform, no shading, no gradient, no texture, no checkerboard, no drop shadows onto it. Each medallion must be fully separated from its neighbours by magenta on all sides. TOP-LEFT: a colossal broken jawbone arch of pale ancient bone rising out of black water, split and toppling, with one small intact ship sailing out through the gap beneath it, tiny against the bone. TOP-CENTRE: an enormous drowned hand of grey stone-like flesh sinking wrist-first into black water, a single bright cutlass driven clean through the wrist, pale bubbles trailing upward. TOP-RIGHT: dead flat black water closing over a vast dark shape barely visible below the surface, one last silver bubble rising, utterly still, faint moonlight on the water, a scene of quiet after violence. BOTTOM-LEFT: three ship hulls fanned out side by side like a dealt hand of cards, each hull a different livery, one bone white, one deep indigo, one dark crimson, sails furled. BOTTOM-RIGHT: two newly framed crew berths side by side inside the same salvaged rib cage of a wreck, both fitted out with hammock and lantern, warm light in both against the cold bone around them. BOTTOM-CENTRE: a single freshly framed crew berth built into the salvaged rib cage of a great wreck, raw new timber lashed against ancient pale bone, one lantern lit inside it. No lettering, no numbers, no words, no runes that read as text anywhere in the image.
